Thank you for taking the time to participate in our survey. This survey aims to develop a tool that can help people choose the right over-the-counter (OTC) medicines/products and exercises to reduce knee joint pain. You will be asked to fill out a questionnaire to share your experience and the level of satisfaction concerning the OTC medicines/products you used and the exercises you practiced for knee joint pain.

 
This survey should take approximately 10-15 minutes to complete and is voluntary. You can skip the questions you are not comfortable with and stop at any point. There are no foreseeable risks to your participation and there are no direct benefits to participating in the research. To protect your confidentiality, no names will be collected. Your input to this survey will not be identifiable in any reports, publications, and presentations related to this survey. No one other than the researchers associated with this project will have access to the raw data.

 
If you have any questions about this research, please contact Dr. Catherine Jai (catherine.jai@ttu.edu) or Dr. Leslie Shen (leslie.shen@ttuhsc.edu). If you have questions about your rights as a research participant, contact the Human Research Protection Program, Office of Research & Innovation, Texas Tech University, Lubbock, Texas 79409, phone: 806-742-2064, and email: hrpp@ttu.edu.
